components.css: .ds-button-dark { display: inline-flex; min-height: 52px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; padding: 0 21px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 11px; color: #fffefa; background: var(--ink); font-family: "DM Sans Variable", sans-serif; font-weight: 750; line-height: 1.1; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, color 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out, transform 160ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-dark:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #2a4033; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-dark:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-button-dark:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: 0.64; } .ds-button-dark:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; min-height: 82px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 0 clamp(24px, 6.3vw, 96px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-family: "DM Sans Variable", sans-serif; } .ds-wordmark { display: inline-flex; flex-shrink: 0; align-items: center; gap: 11px; color: var(--ink); font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-mark { display: grid; width: 34px; height: 34px; flex-shrink: 0; place-items: center; border-radius: 9px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--accent); font-family: "Archivo Variable", sans-serif; font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav { display: flex; min-width: 0; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: clamp(14px, 2.3vw, 30px); } .ds-link { color: var(--ink); font-size: 0.93rem; font-weight: 650; text-underline-offset: 0.25em; } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-button-small { display: inline-flex; min-height: 42px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 9px; color: var(--surface); background: var(--ink); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 750; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-button-small:hover { background: #2a4033; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-small:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-button-small:focus-visible, .ds-link:focus-visible, .ds-wordmark:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 680px) { .ds-header { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; padding: 13px 20px; } .ds-nav { flex: 1 1 100%; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-start; gap: 11px 15px; } }

components.css: .ds-schedule-row { display: grid; align-items: center; grid-template-columns: minmax(180px, 1fr) minmax(260px, 1.25fr) auto; gap: 28px; padding: 25px 7px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink); font-family: "DM Sans Variable", sans-serif; } .ds-class h2 { margin: 0; font-family: "Archivo Variable", sans-serif; font-size: 1.55rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-class p { margin: 9px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-details { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 15px 20px; margin: 0; } .ds-details div:last-child { grid-column: 1 / -1; } .ds-details dt { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.76rem; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-details dd { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--ink); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-row-action { min-width: 132px; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 11px; color: var(--surface); background: var(--ink); font-family: "DM Sans Variable", sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 750; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-row-action:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #2a4033; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-row-action:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-row-action:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: 0.64; } .ds-row-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 820px) { .ds-schedule-row { grid-template-columns: minmax(160px, 0.8fr) minmax(220px, 1.2fr); gap: 20px 26px; } .ds-row-action { justify-self: start; } } @media (max-width: 680px) { .ds-schedule-row { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 18px 16px; padding: 22px 3px; } .ds-details { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 2; } .ds-row-action { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 3; width: 100%; } }

narrative.overview:
“Ritmo en claro” describes the current interface: it gives class times, coaches, capacity, and the next action a plain, quick-to-scan order. A soft paper field and generous page margins keep the experience calm, while dark green ink gives headings and actions a strong anchor.

Práctica 17 extends the familiar account shell from Práctica 16 with open schedule and enrollment rows. Archivo Variable gives the headlines a firm voice; DM Sans Variable carries supporting copy, labels, and fields. The lime mark and action button add a small, high-visibility cue. At narrow widths, navigation gets its own row and class details stack above a full-width action.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-colored pages with a warm white form surface and dark green ink.
A single sharp lime accent for the wordmark mark, selection, and key form action.
Large Archivo headlines paired with practical DM Sans interface text.
Open, divider-separated schedule and enrollment lists with rounded controls.
Responsive layouts that preserve links, details, and actions on small screens.

rules.name: The Lime Signal Rule
rules.body: Keep lime as a brief marker for primary action and brand emphasis; place dark ink on lime instead of white.

rules.name: The Two-Font Rule
rules.body: Use Archivo Variable for headings and the small brand mark; use DM Sans Variable for body copy, labels, fields, and controls.

rules.name: The Open Schedule Rule
rules.body: Keep class and enrollment records in open rows with a 1px divider; do not turn each record into a separate card.

dos: Do use Archivo Variable for headings and the small brand mark, and DM Sans Variable for body copy, labels, fields, and controls.
Do preserve at least 4.5:1 contrast for body text, as required by the direction contract.
Do retain the 3px green keyboard focus outline and preserve all links and actions as the layout stacks.
Do reserve lime for the wordmark mark, selection, and key action, with dark text over the lime.
Do keep schedule and enrollment details readable in open rows with their bottom dividers.
donts: Don't place every schedule or enrollment row inside a separate card; the built lists use open rows.
Don't use white text on the lime action; the implemented contrast pairing is dark accent ink on lime.
Don't add new visual chrome that competes with the class, time, coach, capacity, and enrollment action.
